h1: Custom Kraft Coins for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom kraft coins for your next event or promotion. Perfect for bulk orders. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Kraft coins offer a natural, eco-friendly alternative to standard metal or plastic coins. Made from compressed recycled paper, they provide a unique texture and earthy appearance that stands out at trade shows, fundraisers, or employee recognition programs. Customize them with your logo using foil stamping or screen printing for a distinctive look that aligns with sustainability-focused branding.
heroAltText: Custom kraft coins with foil-stamped logo on natural recycled paper background
